digest.component_or_area: authorship batched ticket map test fixture
propositions: The test fixture incorrectly required a single raw call to build_ticket_position_commit_map to succeed on first attempt, but the function contract explicitly returns {} on Git transient failures (rc nonzero, empty output, or process exception).

Runtime injection of rc=128/empty, rc=0/empty, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) each reproduced the organic CI sequence: first batched call returns {}, immediate identical replay succeeds with all 8 entries against unchanged repository state.
The previous loose-object ENOENT hypothesis was refuted: deleting the implicated 1005 blob left both broad and narrow Git history reads healthy (rc=0, successful SHA resolution).
Test-only bounded recovery (_fixture_batched_map) performs at most five exact resolver attempts, returns on first complete map, and raises with fsck/count-objects diagnostics on persistent failure.
Production authorship fail-closed and per-event fallback semantics remain unchanged; only the test fixture gained bounded recovery.
Both direct equivalence assertions and optimization-count assertions use the bounded recovery seam while preserving exact position-to-SHA expectations.
